title: X-Flare Alert — Satellite Operations
description: An X3.3 flare just erupted from AR 3576 with a fast Earth-directed CME. Your GEO communications satellite is in its path. Kp is still 1.0, but the storm hasn't arrived yet. Do you put the satellite in safe mode?

cmes.note: Full halo CME, estimated arrival in 36h

historicalOutcome: Some operators entered safe mode pre‑emptively and saved their satellites. Others waited and experienced minor anomalies. The CME arrived on schedule, producing a G3 storm.
